EAGLE, ID 7 Day Weather

  1. Stay Informed

    NEWS Releases

  1. Veterans Breakfast - November 14, 2026

    The City of Eagle annual Veterans Breakfast is on Saturday, November 14, 2026, 8am - 10am, at the Eagle Senior Center Read on...

  2. Holiday Season Toy Drive

    Eagle City Hall is a drop off location for Toys-For-Tots donations! Through December 11th bring new and unwrapped toys to city hall (660 E. Civic Ln. Eagle) to benefit children in the Treasure Valley this holiday season. Read on...

  3. Eagle Achieves Class 6 Rating through the National Flood Insurance Program

    The City received a certificate and letter from FEMA congratulating us on our recent increase to Class 6 in the Community Rating System (CRS) of the National Flood Insurance Program. This translates into a 20% savings on flood insurance for residents. Read the letter...

  4. Fall Leaf Recycling - Bag Bundles at City Hall

    Leaf Bag Bundles are now in the City Hall Lobby, while supplies last. One free bundle (5 bags) per household, bring a can of food or two to donate to the Eagle Community Food bank. Read on...

  5. Museum Lecture Series - Arrows & Airways

    Don't miss the next talk in the Museum Lecture Series on December 9, 4:00 p.m., at the Eagle Senior Center. This month is Arrows & Airways: Eagle, Idaho and the Early U.S. Airmail System. Read on...
